_P4_layers: L0:C, L1:C, L2:C, L3:Go, L4:Go/Rust, L5:C#
_P5_brief: Base template for all pure JSON data files following OmniCode 3-block structure

_M1_identity.title: JSON 3-Block Data Template
_M1_identity.role: Anchor template for all pure JSON data files — Genesis 1:1 of JSON structure

_M4_grounding.scripture: 2 Timothy 2:15 — A workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
_M4_grounding.principle: Structure rightly divided enables content rightly placed.

_M5_dependencies.consumers: Any pure JSON data file in the Kingdom Technology Stack

cross_format.role: JSON defines data (what things are). TOML defines configuration (how things work). Both share OmniCode 3-block structure.
cross_format.toml_source: seed/data/L0/toml/config.toml — TOML root (this template derives from it)
cross_format.jsonc_sibling: seed/data/L0/json/3block/config.jsonc — JSONC sibling (same concept, with comments)
cross_format.relationship: This pure JSON template derives from the TOML root for strict data expression.

_M_extension_note.extension: M6+ available for domain-specific metadata in derived files
_M_extension_note.rule: M1-M5 are the base contract. Derived files inherit all five and may extend with M6+ for content their domain requires. Adding M sections to the BASE template requires a schema version bump.

_Cc_format_note: JSON strict — no comments, no trailing commas, UTF-8, LF line endings.
_Cc_key_convention: lowercase_with_underscores for data keys, _prefix for documentation fields
_Co_note: Data values organized by purpose. Real content replaces this section on instantiation.
_Cv_expected_state: Valid JSON with all pragma, metadata, content, and closing blocks present.
_closing_structure: X.1 Policy → X.2 Extension → X.3 Troubleshooting → X.4 Reference → X.5 Note
_X1_scripture: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set. — Proverbs 22:28
_X1_never: Remove required _ fields without updating the schema
_X1_careful: Adding new M sections (requires schema version bump)
_X1_safe: Adding data fields in Co section
Updating values within existing type constraints
_X2_planned: JSON Schema $ref composition for block reuse across templates
Automated validation via ajv in CI pipeline
_X2_considered: JSON-LD context for linked data interoperability
CBOR binary encoding for performance-critical data
_X3_scripture: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God. — James 1:5

_X3_problems.parse error: No trailing commas in JSON. Verify all strings quoted. Check bracket/brace matching.
_X3_problems.encoding issue: UTF-8 required, no BOM. LF line endings only.
_X3_problems.type mismatch: Verify consumer struct tags match JSON keys. Go uses json.Unmarshal tags.
_X3_problems.missing _ fields: Run against json-3block-schema.jsonc to identify missing required fields.

_X4_validate: python -m json.tool data.json && ajv validate -s json-3block-schema.jsonc -d data.json
_X5_note: Pure JSON base template. Copy and modify — every field carries real values, not blanks. The template teaches by being complete, not by being empty.
_X5_scripture: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth. — Genesis 1:1
_X5_anchor: Structure before content. Boundaries before data. This template is the boundary.
